_readme: === Real-world demo (no paid search, no DB) ===
1) fetch-weather: GET Open-Meteo (free, no API key) — real current weather JSON for one fixed location (Mumbai area by default).
2) weather-brief: autogen.agent reads merged input (HTTP status + body) and writes a short plain-English workout weather brief.
Runner: OPENAI_API_KEY or WFENGINE_OPENAI_API_KEY. Outbound HTTPS to api.open-meteo.com and OpenAI.
Studio: Import this JSON, set Initial data to {} (optional: add a note in task later). Click Run.
Edit fetch-weather config url: set latitude= and longitude= to your coordinates (Open-Meteo global grid).
See also: weather-10d-report-email.json (linear CSV + email); weather-10d-mfa-team.json (multi-agent + tools).

config.systemPrompt:
You help people decide if outdoor or gym time is reasonable given live weather data.

The user message will include merged workflow JSON. Look for the HTTP result: if `ok` is true, `body` is Open-Meteo JSON (current_weather has temperature, windspeed, weathercode). If the request failed or `body` is missing, say you could not load weather and suggest checking a local app.

Output (plain text, no markdown tables):
- 2–4 short sentences: temp, wind, and one practical tip for someone going to the gym or running outside in that city.
- One closing line: data source = Open-Meteo (not a forecast guarantee).
